# OpenType Font File

## Summary
The font specialization for OpenType (`.otf`).
An instance is an uploaded realm file with card semantics: the binary lives at
the file URL while the card carries extracted metadata and renders with
format-aware templates.

## Shape
Extends `FontDef`. Adds no fields and no extraction of its own: `FontDef` already reads the sfnt tables
that OpenType and TrueType share, so this def exists to pin the accept types
and display identity for CFF-outline fonts. The distinction that matters
downstream is glyph outline format, not metadata shape.

Accepts: `.otf, font/otf`

## Example
```ts
import { OtfDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/otf-font-def';

@field attachment = linksTo(OtfDef);
```
Instances are created by upload (`createFileDef` wires the type from the
MIME type). Live examples need uploaded fixtures — `Spec` has no field that
accepts a file today (`linkedExamples` is `linksToMany(CardDef)`, and
`FileDef` is a sibling of `CardDef`), so the example check stays open for
every file def until `fileExamples` lands.
